methodHandling.otherMethods: Not checked; any method behaves like GET.

auth.notes: Authenticated only; the userId is discarded - NO ownership check on jobId.

query.name: jobId
query.parse: searchParams.get('jobId'); URL-encoded into the upstream path
query.invalidBehaviour: missing/empty -> 400 'Missing jobId'; unknown id -> upstream 404 -> 502 'PPTX service error'

bodyShape.status: string - upstream status verbatim (SlideForge/Slide Studio vocabulary: queued | running | done | failed)

errors.when: upstream non-2xx, including 404 for an unknown or reaped (24h) job
missing PPTX_API_URL/TOKEN, network failure, upstream 2xx non-JSON

externalCalls: GET ${PPTX_API_URL}/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(jobId)} with Authorization: Bearer ${PPTX_API_TOKEN} (pptx-status.ts:14-16). Not paid (status read).
quirks: No ownership check: any authenticated user can poll any SlideForge job id (pptx-status.ts:7).
Status vocabulary is passed through from upstream; docs claim 'pending' but upstream uses queued/running (slidestudio compat store.py:15).
If upstream body lacks 'status', response is {"done":false,"failed":false} (status key dropped by JSON.stringify).
Upstream error/progress fields (e.g. error text on failed jobs, slidestudio routes.py:145-150) are NOT forwarded.
Unknown job -> 502 (not 404), so callers cannot distinguish 'gone' from 'service down'. Auxi_Connector deliberately treats 502 as 'still running' (forge.py:828-869).
Also polls jobs created by /api/image-to-slide (same upstream job namespace).

callers.expects: reads done/failed booleans only; non-2xx -> rejects the export

callers.where: C:/Github/Auxi_Connector/app/api/routes/forge.py:828-869 (_check_conversion, default endpoint /api/pptx-status param jobId); image_slide.py:325-339 uses it for image-to-slide jobs
callers.expects: exception/5xx/429 -> running; other 4xx -> terminal error 'PPTX status failed (<status>)'; 2xx unparseable -> running; done if data.done or status=='done'; failed if data.failed or status=='failed'

docs.openapi: public/openapi.yaml:1037-1054 - schema PptxJobStatus (openapi.yaml:375-384) enumerates status [pending, done, failed]; actual upstream values are queued|running|done|failed. No error responses documented.
